title: peatfire-eval: panel construction and evaluation-protocol experiments for district-month fire severity forecasting in West Kalimantan
description:
Code and derived data accompanying the manuscript Evaluation protocol choices determine model rankings in fire hotspot prediction: evidence from West Kalimantan, Indonesia.

Builds a district-month panel of VIIRS S-NPP active fire detections for the 14 districts of West Kalimantan, Indonesia, 2012 to 2026, using GADM 4.1 administrative boundaries rather than a bounding box, and evaluates seven forecasting models under a 2x2 design crossing the test distribution (balanced or natural prevalence) with the discrimination metric (ROC-AUC or AUC-PR). Includes severity-threshold sensitivity at the 80th, 90th, and 95th percentiles, an extreme-year holdout, isotonic calibration fitted on training folds only, and a negative result for the Indian Ocean Dipole.

The derived panel of 2,464 district-months is included. Raw FIRMS detections and GADM boundaries are not redistributed; both are free to obtain and the README documents how.
